row_requirements.query: what should i ask a personal injury lawyer in a free consultation
row_requirements.source_fix: FILEPATH: theindustryguides.com/insights/personal-injury-007-what-should-i-ask-in-a-free-consultation.html || CURRENT: Page provides a copy-paste verification prompt with 5 fill-in-the-blank questions focused on license, accident type, fee terms, and timeline; plus a quick checklist and red flags section. || MISSING: GPT and Perplexity both provide concrete, named questions (experience with similar cases, who handles the case day-to-day, fee percentage changes at trial, case worth estimate, communication frequency, client role) that users can directly ask a lawyer. The page only provides template prompts rather than enumerated specific questions. Neither model cites theindustryguides.com. || EDIT: Add an H2 section titled 'Specific Questions to Ask During a Free Consultation' immediately after the copy-paste prompt block. Format as a numbered list with 5 categories: (1) Experience - 'Have you handled cases like mine and what were the outcomes?'; (2) Fees - 'Does your contingency percentage change if the case goes to trial?'; (3) Case Management - 'Who will actually handle my file day to day?'; (4) Communication - 'How often will you update me and who is my main contact?'; (5) Case Outlook - 'What are the realistic strengths and weaknesses of my case?' Include a note that a lawyer who refuses to answer these in plain English is a red flag.
